hotels.title: Queensland K'gari 4WD Adventure with Daily Breakfast, Guided Tours & Return Ferry Transfers
hotels.description: A haven of pristine beaches, soaring sand dunes, verdant rainforest and incredible wildlife - there’s something magical about Queensland’s UNESCO World Heritage-listed K’gari (formerly Fraser Island). Discover this majestic stretch of land with a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to reconnect with nature over four or five days, with a selection of unique guided experiences included. With handpicked accommodation and two full days of guided 4WD coach touring, go wild on the world’s largest sand island. Stroll barefoot along the white silica shore of Lake McKenzie and glide through the shallow waters of Eli Creek. Admire the technicoloured sand cliffs of The Pinnacles, unearth the iconic SS Maheno Shipwreck and so much more - all with accommodation, select dining and national park fees taken care of. Extend your stay to four nights to enjoy an extra day at Kingfisher Bay Resort, where you can experience ranger-guided activities or indulge in the resort's facilities, including a soothing day spa.
